data.one_liner: NoSQL persistent embedded database for the Web on top of IndexedDB.
data.what_it_does: Provides a NoSQL embedded database implementation for web applications using IndexedDB as the underlying storage. It supports cross-tab synchronization and transactions.
use_when: You need a NoSQL embedded database specifically for Flutter Web or browser applications.
You want data to synchronize across multiple open browser tabs.
avoid_when: You are looking for a relational SQL database solution.
You require built-in data encryption via codecs (which are not supported).
strengths: Content and transactions are synchronized across all open browser tabs.
Supports both JS and WASM targets.
weaknesses: Codecs are not supported on the web.
Transactions must be idempotent because they may run again in case of concurrent access.
data.setup_notes: Add sembast_web to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative NoSQL database for Flutter and Dart.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler key-value storage alternative if a full NoSQL database is overkill.
